SEPTIC ARTHRITIS (NATIVE JOINT) WITH ENTEROCOCCI

Administer parenteral therapy initially then can be converted to appropriate

oral therapy.

Duration of treatment for 2-4 weeks, depending on response

# Treatment, MILD-MODERATE infections

[Amoxicillin 500 mg PO TID \($\) R](psozid2-amoxicillin-14ds-500mg-po-tid)

[Non-VA order for above](pshzid2-amoxicillin-14ds-500mg-po-tid)

# Treatment, SEVERE infections

Refer to Inpatient Antimicrobial CDSS.

[References](orzid2-gmenu-abx-references)

Mandell chapter: Infectious arthritis of native joints

Sanford keyword: Septic arthritis

Stevens DL Clin Inf Dis 2014, 59:e10-52
